Gradmint Technologies brings together two things that belong together: technology that solves real problems and people with the skills to build it.

Based in Hyderabad, our focus is practical progress. For businesses, that means thoughtful digital solutions. For students and graduates, it means learning through real projects, guided mentorship and internship experience.

We’re here to make the journey from “what if” to “what’s next” a little clearer—and a lot more achievable.
